prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square pictorial commander enhancement icon for a compact RTS game, transparent PNG.
Primary request: create a beautifully readable military science fiction machine component icon with the functional visual language of Supreme Commander Forged Alliance enhancement buttons. Original component design for our Varkan industrial faction. One isolated component, no unit portrait, no UI frame and no lettering.
Style/medium: hand-finished 3D game icon, restrained bevelled cast steel and dark graphite panels, bright silver edges, a few warm copper mechanical fittings, strong clean silhouette. Rich chunky volumes and purposeful mechanism instead of flat line art.
Composition/framing: three-quarter perspective, entire object visible and centered in square, occupies 80 percent of canvas, 10 percent safe margin on each side. Strong readability when shrunk to 32 pixels. Actual transparent background.
Lighting/mood: broad soft light from upper left and subtle rim light, strong separation of solid forms, no extreme glossy reflections.
Color palette: neutral graphite and silver steel only, modest copper details. No baked blue faction paint. The coded UI supplies colored faction selection backgrounds.
Constraints: no text, letter, number, logo, watermark, badge, square border, environment, scene, human, complete robot body, tiny wires, fine busy detail or exterior glow. Only one bold component with alpha transparency.

Subject: a robust commander construction forearm module, silver armor cuff above a copper-collared precision fabrication emitter with three thick prongs pointing downward-right. A visible chunky mechanical joint at upper-left. The machine is a nanolathe construction tool, its tip visibly distinct from a gun barrel.
